digest.component_or_area: git fetch timeout handling across multiple network call sites
propositions: Three 300s wall-clock git fetch sites (gerrit_client, opcert_service, init) lack throughput-keyed stall detection and retain full timeout exposure identical to the snapshot fetch vulnerability fixed in 12e4
gerrit_client, opcert_service, and init git fetches must splice stall_abort_args() to pass low-speed options instead of relying on wall-clock timeouts alone
A zero-byte remote must abort on throughput stall within ~10s, and a dribbling remote above the low-speed floor must not be aborted, across all three fetch sites
The stall abort logic must be reused from git_fetch module without duplication across the three call sites
Module size constraint (800 LOC cap) required moving stall abort arming from init.py to _init_probe.run_bounded_git, and fetch-only conditioning to avoid breaking existing test dispatch logic
